**About‑us** – Faded Archive is a Manchester‑based shop that creates made‑to‑order tees from premium, sustainably sourced fabrics. Each shirt is custom‑printed on demand, so you never waste stock – only the shirts you love. Every design is hand‑approved for quality and comfort, then delivered in a single‑exfoliated, eco‑friendly package. We’re proud to support the local community by using Manchester‑based suppliers whenever possible and by actively reducing waste across our production chain.

**Logo colour** – a deep charcoal (hex #333333) works best; it’s subtle, modern, and pairs well with our earthy palette.
